_doc: Curated comparator registry for Table 6 of the v9 report.
rows   : admitted comparators, each tagged with a group id.
pending: evidence that exists but is NOT admitted to any group yet, because
its split / label protocol / leak status has not been verified.
* A row may only enter rows[] if task, modality set, label protocol and split
match the row it is compared with.
* paper-reported and locally-reproduced numbers never mix inside one column.
* local_reproduction=true requires a checkpoint + FINAL_RESULT.json in this repo.
This work's own rows are injected automatically by report_v9.py; do not duplicate them here.

pending.method: Text pooling (mean-pool text feature + linear head)
pending.why_pending: Single-seed historical diagnostic from the pre-v9 SIMS cache. No checkpoint in this repository; the dev/test provenance of the recorded number cannot be re-derived, so it is not admitted as a matched comparator.

BLOCKED, not merely unverified: receipt.json does not state whether the h[4096] fusion features were fitted on train+valid together. Until that provenance is audited this number may embed train/valid leakage. It must not be quoted as a bar to beat. See TASK_INVENTORY_20260914.md item 3.

hold_note: No externally published row is admitted in this revision.

input modality set could not be matched to a row measured here, and the paper numbers have
not been independently re-verified. Rather than relax the matching rule, external
comparators stay out of the tables. Rows can be added to rows[] the moment a candidate is
